originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: Separate reversible binding, catalytic transformation and a downstream cellular effect; read half occupancy without inferring death.
originalFrozenTask.gap: The current independent binding/reaction input map is scientifically useful, but both operations are represented as abstract labels. A small paired molecular schematic would show an unchanged ligand bound/released versus substrate converted to product, while the formula remains ordinary text.
accuracyGuardrails: Do not equate Kd, Km or IC50; affinity is not selectivity, binding occupancy is not cell death, and the simple one-site/free-ligand assumptions must remain beside arithmetic.

generatorCustody: Original generator privately retained, not publicly delivered; editable SVG without an executable reproduction-package promise.
sourceDepth: Actual primary abstracts and selected primary/official passages; exact per-owner private lookup/depth/failure/custody receipts. No whole-paper/clinical/scientific approval implied.
themeMethod: Exact shared geometry and wording, palette substitutions only
